title: The Garden of Highmoor
author: Ivo Zhou
blurb: Casper Hartwell, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
